name: Secret Bay
positioning: All-villa Relais & Chateaux resort in Dominica, with private plunge pool villas, a treehouse-style spa and beaches reached through the resort or by water
best_for: Couples wanting a secluded villa with a private plunge pool and beaches reached by kayak or paddle
Families or friends who want to combine neighbouring villas into a private estate, with a kids concierge

facts.text: Secret Bay is an all-villa Caribbean resort in Dominica.
Secret Bay is a member of Relais & Chateaux.
The villas have private plunge pools.
Guests have dedicated villa hosts and an on-call concierge.
The Cario River winds through the property.
The oceanfront lap pool is set amid an orchard of guava trees.
Bwa Denn is home to more than 100 Caribbean and Latin American art pieces.
The watersports base offers kayaks, paddleboards and snorkel gear.
The Friends & Family villas have jungle-to-ocean views extending from Morne Diablotin to sunsets over the Caribbean Sea.
Guests may combine select neighbouring villas connected by private pathways into a private estate.
Secret Bay has a kids concierge and young adult offerings.
Zing Zing is an open-air restaurant above Tibay Beach with twenty seats and a six-course Discovery Menu.

highlights.text: Secret Beach is reached solely by kayak, paddle, swim or skiff and has a hidden sea cave.
The Gommier Spa is a treehouse-style retreat overlooking Tibay Beach.
A funicular ascends 400 linear feet into the coastal jungle to the Clifftop, Hillside and Summit villas.
Tibay Beach is a swimmable beach that can be reached solely through Secret Bay or by water.
Yoga is held at the Bwa Mang Wellness Pavilion, suspended over the Cario River.

considerations.text: Secret Bay is an off-the-beaten-track destination in Dominica; the Travel Concierge helps coordinate commercial flights, private charters or boat travel.
Zing Zing is open seasonally and limited to 20 guests per evening.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that may not suit all budgets.
